i18n.enTitle: Compare AI agents! Differences between 15 major services for business and evaluation sheet for approval process
i18n.enSummary: The more I read comparison articles on AI agents, the more candidates I have, and the more I find it difficult to narrow down the products that suit my company. In this article, we will explain a comparison table of 15 major services divided into three types, the differences between products that can be confusing, and an evaluation sheet that can be used for approval, based on official information as of November 2026. When you open a comparison table of AI agents, you will often see the general-purpose ChatGPT, the building platform Copilot Studio, and the development tool Claude Code all listed in the same table. Even if you compare different types of products in one table, you won't be able to decide which one is right for your company.
